A00.recollectionDescription: Summons a choice of items that increase the strength of your soul. Usually increasing the damage you deal to bosses.

A05.recollectionDescription: +Gain a 3 second status effect when hit or near bullets for a short time, providing a 50% Weapon Power Increase

A06.recollectionDescription: +Shots shove bullets and bosses out of the way +30% Shot Speed

A07.recollectionDescription: +Future shots gain a power boost whenever hitting bosses. This effect resets when missing a shot.

A08.recollectionSummary: Big Damage Up, Fast Burn Out

A11.recollectionDescription: +Create a damaging forcefield around the soul that also blocks off bullets.

A12.recollectionDescription: +33% Nearby Soul Shot Leakage +10% Shot Power +10% Essence Cost

A14.recollectionDescription: +Creates an aura around your shots, which does up to 50% shot damage over a second.

B00.recollectionDescription: Summons a choice of items that increase the vitality of your soul. Usually increasing the health of the soul.

B02.recollectionDescription: +2 Defense, lowering damage taken from all sources by 2

B03.recollectionDescription: +When losing a heart gain an extra airbag heart, which shoots out an airbag when in danger. Also loses it's max HP whenever hit.

B04.recollectionDescription: +Hearts Survive an additional Lethal Hit +2 Base Heart HP

B05.recollectionDescription: Boss Bullets that hit the soul bounce back at bosses dealing extra damage, however the soul also bounces back +35% Soul Damage Reduction

B06.recollectionDescription: +40% heart special effect boost. +Upgrade one lesser heart into a special heart.

B07.recollectionDescription: +Creates encouragement throughout the field, which heals the soul. If the soul is full on HP then essence is restored instead.

B08.recollectionDescription: +Holding still for a brief moment will trigger a self love buff, that instantly heals the soul a bit. +2 Base Heart HP

B09.recollectionDescription: +Damaging bosses creates speech hearts, collecting these heals the soul and does small additional damage.

B10.recollectionDescription: +Damage bosses and heals the soul when nearby.

B11.recollectionDescription: +Adds a boost that regenerates 6 hp over 6 seconds when hit as long as you are not hit again.

B12.recollectionDescription: +Bosses gain an extra heart familiar. Damaging the heart damages the boss and heals the soul.

B14.recollectionDescription: +On hit creates a powerful heart shot that home on bosses. This dampens bullets and does up to 1200% Revenge Damage

C00.recollectionDescription: Summons a choice of items that increase the essence of your soul. Usually increasing the essence regen of the soul.

C01.recollectionDescription: Increases essence regen the longer each battle lasts, up to 60% essence regen

C05.recollectionDescription: +Charged up essence field rapidly does damage to nearby bosses, also restoring essence.

C06.recollectionDescription: +Charged up essence field rapidly dampens nearby bullets, also restoring essence.

C07.recollectionDescription: If not shooting for a brief moment, reload which restores 100 essence.

C08.recollectionDescription: +Once per field when running out of essence, trigger 3 Seconds of 200% more essence regen and 50% more think speed.

C09.recollectionDescription: +When hit gain an instant 150 essence, which can go over your current maximum.

C10.recollectionDescription: +Gain extra essence regen and firerate the lower your current heart health is. Up to 120% Essence Regen and 60% Think Speed

C11.recollectionDescription: +30% Shot Power +100% Essence Cost, excess essence can be re-collected by the soul for a brief moment.

C12.recollectionDescription: +Create an essence pool at the cost of 3 HP when running out of essence. Pool restores up to 150 essence over 6 seconds.

C14.recollectionDescription: +Attacks that cost more than 20 essence have their essence cost reduced by 50% past that.

D00.recollectionDescription: Summons a choice of items that increase the dexterity of your soul. Usually increasing the speed and firerate of the soul.

D03.recollectionDescription: +All shots lob now, which also travel the same distance over a shorter time +Gain an additional shot dealing 40% damage

D05.recollectionDescription: +When near bullets or hit for a moment, gain a temporary 50% Move/Think Speed and 1/2 Second of Invincibility

D06.recollectionDescription: +Shots do extra damage proportional to their speed, 30% shorter shot lifespan +Massive shot acceleration

D11.recollectionDescription: +4 initial shot speed and damage that rapidly dissipates

D12.recollectionDescription: +Teleporting causes a gust of wind, which pushes back bullets and bosses and does small damage.

D14.recollectionDescription: +Soul movement causes pressure, which blows back bullets and does damage. +30% Movement Speed

E00.recollectionDescription: Summons a choice of items that increase the perception of your soul. Usually increasing your warp rate, and lowering weapon drain rate.

E03.recollectionDescription: +100% Weapon Accuracy +20% Shot Speed -15% Weapon Essence Cost

E08.recollectionDescription: +Occasionally dampens bullets, causing them to be smaller and less damaging.

E09.recollectionDescription: +Slowdown to Bullets and Bosses when teleporting.

E10.recollectionDescription: +When shooting sometimes stop all nearby bullets and do damage to bosses. Frequency depends on the potency of the original attack.

E13.recollectionDescription: +Hyper sense nearby bullets, this slightly staggers them, recharges your teleport faster, and regains essence.

E14.recollectionDescription: +Teleporting generates a duplicate soul that lingers and shoots for a bit.

F00.recollectionDescription: Summons a choice of items that increase the state of your soul. Usually increasing transformation duration and recharge rate.

F03.recollectionDescription: +Deal massive damage to everything on the screen and push bullets way back when transforming +Smaller effect kept after transforming

F05.recollectionDescription: +Gain extra power in base equivalent to 15% of your state's power.

F06.recollectionDescription: +When hit gain some state +Additional state when losing a heart

F07.recollectionDescription: +Any time a boss fight lasts more than 8 seconds you gain chance to instantly gain max state and transform.

F08.recollectionDescription: +Every time you transform the soul gains permanent stat boosts equivalent to 1/4 of a stat level.

F09.recollectionDescription: -50% State Teleport Cost +25% Teleport Effect Power +20% State Duration

G01.recollectionDescription: Dream Gems can absorb the power of the soul's imagination and shoot it out at bosses! Takes weapon power adds splash damage to it and then shoots it with high speed.

G02.recollectionDescription: Dream Gems can absorb the power of the soul's imagination and shoot it out at bosses! Takes weapon power adds a chance for dealing triple damage to it and then shoots it with high speed.

G03.recollectionDescription: Dream Gems can absorb the power of the soul's imagination and shoot it out at bosses! Takes weapon power adds splitting to it and then shoots it with high speed.

G04.recollectionDescription: Dream Gems can absorb the power of the soul's imagination and shoot it out at bosses! Takes weapon power adds knockback to it and then shoots it with 10% more power!

G05.recollectionDescription: Dream Gems can absorb the power of the soul's imagination and shoot it out at bosses! Takes weapon power adds the chance for duplicating the projectile to it and then shoots it with high speed.

G06.recollectionDescription: Dream Gems can absorb the power of the soul's imagination and shoot it out at bosses! Takes weapon power adds freezing to it and then shoots it with high speed.

H02.recollectionDescription: +15 HP -30% Soul/Shot Size -20% Shot Damage +30% Move Speed and 50% Think Speed

H03.recollectionDescription: +20 HP +Can survive an extra 2 lethal hits leaving the heart in a broken but repairable state.

H04.recollectionDescription: +40 HP Large Heart +30% Soul/Shot Size and Damage -20% Soul Move and Think Speed

H05.recollectionDescription: +Regens health much faster when soul is full on essence. Regens essence much faster when heart is full.

H06.recollectionDescription: +10 HP +The heart comes back 3 rooms after it dies

H07.recollectionDescription: +20 HP +When moving spawn gas clouds that poison bosses and push stuff away.

H08.recollectionDescription: +20HP +Shoot out spikes from the soul when near danger that push bullets and deal damage.

H09.recollectionDescription: +20 HP +Blade that slashes bosses, inflicting deep bleed that does big damage, but also leaks out bullets.

H11.recollectionDescription: +20 HP +Gain massive fire rate and propulsion the longer the soul shoots. +Wind up and Wind down time.

H12.recollectionDescription: +20 HP +If at/above max essence: Damage every enemy on screen with lightning, costing some essence. +30% Essence Regen

H13.recollectionDescription: +20 HP +Increases soul attack rate and movement speed when low on HP.

H14.recollectionDescription: +25 HP +The soul bites towards bosses. These bites do damage, and regenerate health.

H15.recollectionDescription: +20 HP +Gives the soul a 50% chance of shooting back enemy projectiles and negating damage.

H16.recollectionDescription: +20 HP +When damaged, has a large chance of redirecting the damage to another heart slot.

H17.recollectionDescription: +20 HP +While active, gives the soul a slippery bubble trail.

J08.recollectionDescription: +30% Figment Damage +30% Figment Health +1 Lesser Heart

L01.recollectionDescription: +Each weapon now has an extra bit of initial essence that also has a shorter delay.

L03.recollectionDescription: +Upgrade your currently held weapon. Weapons shoot 16% faster and consume 16% less essence per level.

L04.recollectionDescription: +Losing a heart will give you a permanent 1/4 Level to a random basic stat.

M01.recollectionDescription: +This soul seems a bit lost, luckily it's on your side. Shoots at bosses and loosely follows your soul. More souls wander into your party the longer the fight goes on.

M02.recollectionDescription: +Unlike souls, figments are corporeal. Bosses will target and shoot them, however the figments can die if they are hit too much.

M03.recollectionDescription: +Follows bosses and shoots pretty quick for a soul.

M04.recollectionDescription: +Comedic punching bag, bosses will target this figment instead of the soul.

M05.recollectionDescription: +Shoots fire essence at bosses, if your projectiles go through this soul they will also be set on fire for extra damage!

M06.recollectionDescription: +Shoots powerful imaginary explosives at the enemies.

M07.recollectionDescription: +Shoots gunpowder, if your projectiles pass through this soul they will gain explosiveness!

M08.recollectionDescription: +Produces healthy thinking that heals you if you pick it up!

M09.recollectionDescription: +Shoots spike essence at the enemies, Increases the pierce of your passing projectiles and shot power.

M10.recollectionDescription: +When hit will retaliate with a barrage of green essence!

M11.recollectionDescription: +Chases down bosses, doing big damage to them.

M12.recollectionDescription: +When colliding with a boss will shoot a bunch of shots that are followed by soul damaging bullets.

M14.recollectionDescription: +Rushes to bosses, explodes when it dies doing big damage!

M15.recollectionDescription: +Shoots poisonous essence, doing damage over time. If your projectiles pass through they also gain poison damage!

M16.recollectionDescription: +Increases productivity. Produces essence and blocks enemy bullets.

M17.recollectionDescription: +A Soul cursed to inflict sharp damage and make enemies bleed! Will make any projectiles passing through also inflict bleed.

M18.recollectionDescription: +Sucks up any nearby bullets into the endless void that is its mouth. Imaginative Appetite.

M19.recollectionDescription: +Powerful wizard soul that can home in on enemies. Projectiles passing through gain homing and magic.

M20.recollectionDescription: +Produces positive thinking that gives you various stat boosts if you pick it up!

M21.recollectionDescription: +Electrical Soul that shoots chain shots. Projectiles passing through gain chain and energy.

M22.recollectionDescription: +Shooting this figment will damage it and cause it to shoot powerful projectiles.

M23.recollectionDescription: +Ally orbits soul and shoots barriers to block out enemy bullets.

M24.recollectionDescription: +Orbits the soul, redirecting projectiles until the dream fades away.

M25.recollectionDescription: +Scares bosses and boss bullets, causing bosses to take extra damage from all sources.

N02.recollectionDescription: +Lightbulb that follows the soul, produces extra recalls if lit at the end of boss fights.

N03.recollectionDescription: +Now the soul can shoot all of its weapons at the same time, at half their normal firerate.

N04.recollectionDescription: +Replace all of your current weapons with random weapons that are one tier higher than their current one.

OA01.recollectionDescription: +1 Recalls per Boss Fight +1 Item Choice

OA02.recollectionDescription: +Convert nearby bullets into wisps that follow the soul and deal damage.

OA03.recollectionDescription: +Instead of taking items from the current field, you now gain the option to pick 2 random items that can be anything.

OA04.recollectionDescription: +Your shots gradually become bigger and more powerful.

OA05.recollectionDescription: +Sometimes grants the soul the ability to pick which item pool to pick items from.

OA06.recollectionDescription: +The soul gains a very low chance to create an immensely powerful shot that has a powerful aura which damages enemies and erases bullets.

OB02.recollectionDescription: -50% Weapon Cost +40% Weapon Attack Rate +Shots change directions randomly

OB03.recollectionDescription: +While in the happy place gain a big boost to health, essence, and shot rethink speed.

OB04.recollectionDescription: +Continously shoot extra shots at half the usual rate, which cost 30% as much essence.

OB06.recollectionDescription: +Shots burst in 4 directions when near bosses.

OC01.recollectionSummary: Boss and Soul Attack Speed Up

OC02.recollectionDescription: +Your sense of security manifests itself in the form of a more secure final heart.

OC03.recollectionDescription: +All weapons are now 4x barrages that stick to their initial firing angle, and use up 3x essence and 3x reload time. +1 existing barrage count.

OC04.recollectionDescription: +Deal 30% more damage to enemies, however upon getting hit in a boss fight you will recieve 50% more damage until the end of that field.

OC05.recollectionDescription: +All shots fired will follow a direct line toward your cursor.

OC06.recollectionDescription: +Shots split in 2 when near bosses in widely different directions.

P01.recollectionDescription: +200 Essence at the start of each room.

P02.recollectionDescription: +1/4 Levels to all Basic Stats +1/2 Hope and Despair Levels

P03.recollectionDescription: +1/2 Loathing +When hit unleash a vindictive soul spirit, does damage and life steal. Stronger based on loathing stat

P04.recollectionDescription: +4 Paranoia +Being careful causes the soul to regenerate health faster when in potential danger.

P05.recollectionDescription: +3x Weapon Power +2.5x Weapon Cost +2x Weapon Delay

P06.recollectionDescription: +25% chance to shoot a poisonous shot that does 2 damage per second over 6 seconds

P07.recollectionDescription: +16% chance to shoot fiery shots, which can pierce. They also apply a burn that does 4 damage per second over 3 seconds.

P08.recollectionDescription: +Constantly create shots that passively float around for a while.

P09.recollectionDescription: +Every 7th time you use your weapon you shoot in 5 different directions at once. +1/2 Loathing

P10.recollectionDescription: +20% Bullet/Shot Slowdown Aura +50% Shot Lifespan +1/4 Bliss

P11.recollectionSummary: Snap Shots and Bullets in Place
P11.recollectionDescription: +Cause soul shots and boss bullets to get stuck in time. They are still capable of doing damage during this time.

Q01.recollectionDescription: +Occasionally shoot free extra shots that automatically aim at the nearest enemy.

Q02.recollectionDescription: +40% chance for recycling thoughts. When your thoughts expire from running out of their lifespan, they have a chance to get shot again from the soul.

Q03.recollectionDescription: +Shot Projectiles spawn away from soul and then travel back to the cursor.

Q05.recollectionDescription: +The soul now sometimes has its thoughts replaced with banana peels. These redirect any bullets that come in contact with them. They also can make the soul slip.

S01.recollectionDescription: +Receiving damage or being near bullets causes the soul to shoot piercing shots in all directions. +1/4 Paranoia

S02.recollectionDescription: +Receiving damage causes the soul to get backup from a powerful ally soul

S03.recollectionDescription: +Receiving damage causes the soul to get emotional support from a powerful ally figment

S04.recollectionDescription: +Losing hearts give you a coping heart replacement. This heart steadily loses its max hp, but can shoot extra projectiles at the enemy.

S05.recollectionSummary: Comfort in Zones, Pain outside Zones
S05.recollectionDescription: +Spawns several comfort zones that heal and refresh the soul when within them, and damage the soul when outside them. +1/4 Assurance +1/4 Paranoia

S06.recollectionDescription: +When hit you shoot bubbles everywhere. Washes your headspace.

T01.recollectionDescription: +Allows you to swap all the items in a field to different items for a price.

T02.recollectionDescription: +Quickly suck up all the knowledge/items a field has to offer. One time usage.

T03.recollectionDescription: +Get inspired. You can activate this ability in any item field to increase the potency of the items in that field.

T04.recollectionDescription: +Gives you a choice of 4 items that you previously picked up to give +2 stacks to.

T05.recollectionDescription: +Allows the soul to teleport back to it's original position after teleporting. This is free of charge and counts as a second teleport.

U01.recollectionDescription: +All soul projectiles bounce off walls now. Can't get these ideas out of my head.

U02.recollectionDescription: +Gives the soul a big boost if a room lasts more than 10 seconds. Sudden burst of energy out of nowhere.

U03.recollectionDescription: +By keeping up a train of thought, slowly gain up to 100% firerate and 50% lower essence cost with a weapon as long as you do not change shooting angle.

U04.recollectionDescription: +All your minions will now circle the soul instead of their typical movement pattern. They also all shoot 10% faster.

U05.recollectionDescription: +Connecting your ideas allows them to hit 2 extra targets in a single shot.

U06.recollectionDescription: +150% Think Speed -40% Shot Power -40% Essence Cost

U07.recollectionDescription: +Being close to enemies and enemy bullets greatly increases your firerate and essence gain.

U08.recollectionDescription: +Every projectile at any moment could instantly explode into a fart. These farts do splash damage and inflict powerful poison on enemies.

U09.recollectionDescription: +12.5% chance to create freezing shots, which can slow down bosses or freeze bullets.

V02.recollectionDescription: +1/2 Hope +Randomly gain lesser hearts after boss fights

V03.recollectionDescription: +1/2 Basic Stat Level per Floor +1/2 Spiritual Stat Level per Floor +1/2 Negative Spiritual Stat Level per Floor

V04.recollectionDescription: +Creates a random dark area on the field, this area does damage to everything it touches. +1/2 Despair

V05.recollectionDescription: +Automatically warp to a nearby location whenever you would have taken damage. +1/4 Assurance, 3/4 Paranoia

V06.recollectionDescription: +Occasionally shoot over-exerted shots that drain three times as much essence but split into 4 targetted burst shots.

V07.recollectionDescription: +Slowly fill up a massive mega shot that does damage to everything on the screen.

V08.recollectionDescription: +Producing shots uses up much less essence. Shots will wander around after a set distance in random directions.

V09.recollectionDescription: +Damaging bosses causes short-ranged healing energy to leak out of bosses. +1/2 Loathing

W01.recollectionDescription: +Deal damage to everything in between your origin and destination when teleporting.

W02.recollectionDescription: +Shoot out excess teleporting energy in the form of projectiles. Projectiles aim toward the nearest enemy/boss.

W03.recollectionDescription: +A love of bending space allows you to heal yourself when teleporting.

W04.recollectionDescription: +Plants a bomb in the inital location during soul teleports.

W05.recollectionDescription: +Clears every bullet on screen when teleporting for the first time in each boss battle.

W06.recollectionDescription: +Create lingering rifts in headspace when teleporting, allowing things to warp between the two points. Projectiles passing through gain momentum, and can hit enemies again.

XA01.recollectionDescription: +20% Soul Damage -40% Soul Accuracy +30% Boss Damage

XA02.recollectionDescription: +Boss shots occasionally are overloaded with hatred, causing them to deal double damage and move faster. The same is applied to soul shots.

XA03.recollectionDescription: +Being hit or near danger increases your temper. When experiencing a temper tantrum shoot uncontrollably and inaccurately at 3x speed.

XA04.recollectionDescription: +Getting hit has a 1/16 chance to convert the soul's rightmost heart into a seething heart. These hearts lose some of their max HP every room, but let soul shots burn bosses.

XA05.recollectionDescription: +Creates trash talk bubbles on the field, which provoke bosses to shoot out extra bullets, but also recieve big damage.

XA06.recollectionDescription: +Hitting bosses with shots causes them to burst into shots which deal additional damage to both bosses and souls.

XB01.recollectionDescription: -50% Soul/Boss Accuracy +25% Soul/Boss Firerate +40% Bullet Speed

XB02.recollectionDescription: +Soul shots can sometimes shake and explode prior to hitting bosses from nervousness. These shots explode into 5 shots that go in random directions, and cost 3 times as much.

XB03.recollectionDescription: +A panic inducing figment follows behind the soul at a steady pace. This figment shoots bullets that can damage enemies and the soul.

XB05.recollectionDescription: +Bosses sometimes shoot extra bullets at the soul. The soul also can sometimes shoot more.

XB06.recollectionDescription: +Constant crowd of spirits that wander across the stage. Some of which will attack the soul when near.

XC01.recollectionDescription: +2 Boss Fight Power Level +30% Bullet Power +20% Shot Power

XC02.recollectionDescription: +Shots will occasionally suck up everything into them. Also can deal more damage over time.

XC03.recollectionDescription: +Chains the soul to a minion. Heavily restricting soul movement speed past a certain range. The chain itself can be used to deal extra damage to enemies.

XC04.recollectionDescription: +Every time the soul takes damage, all future damage taken by the soul is increased by 2%, and all damage done by the soul is increased by 1.5%

XC05.recollectionDescription: +Every time the soul takes damage, pained spirits will closely follow the soul, which eventually explode dealing extra damage to the soul and anything else nearby.

XC06.recollectionDescription: +Shots trail behind the soul in a conga line. -40% Think Cost +30% Think Speed
